mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS publishedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enabledCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN access_scope = 'RESTRICTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS restrictedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN draft_dirty = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS draftDirtyCount FROM ai_capability_definition

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS publishedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN enabled = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enabledCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN access_scope = 'RESTRICTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS restrictedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN draft_dirty = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS draftDirtyCount FROM ai_workflow_definition

SELECT COUNT(*) AS runCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failedCount, 0 AS partialCount, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 2 ) END AS successRate, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(total_duration_ms)), 0) AS averageDurationMs FROM ai_run_trace WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at < #{endTime}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT runId) AS generatedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN queryType = 'DATA_QUERY' THEN runId END) AS dataQueryCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN queryType = 'ANALYSIS_REPORT' THEN runId END) AS analysisReportCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN analysisStatus = 'DONE' THEN runId END) AS analysisSuccessCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN analysisStatus = 'FAILED' THEN runId END) AS analysisFailedCount FROM ( SELECT message.run_id AS runId, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(message.payload_json) = 1 THEN message.payload_json ELSE NULL END, '$.presentationType' )) AS presentationType, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(message.payload_json) = 1 THEN message.payload_json ELSE NULL END, '$.reportSchema.queryType' )) AS queryType, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT( CASE WHEN JSON_VALID(message.payload_json) = 1 THEN message.payload_json ELSE NULL END, '$.reportSchema.analysis.status' )) AS analysisStatus FROM ai_chat_message message INNER JOIN ai_run_trace trace ON trace.run_id = message.run_id WHERE message.role = 'ASSISTANT' AND trace.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND message.payload_json IS NOT NULL AND JSON_VALID(message.payload_json) = 1 AND message.created_at >= #{startTime} AND message.created_at < #{endTime} ) report_message WHERE presentationType = 'REPORT'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_model_config WHERE enabled = 1

SELECT COUNT(mu.id) AS callCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN mu.success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failureCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(mu.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN mu.success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(mu.id), 2) END AS successRate, COALESCE(SUM(mu.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(mu.duration_ms)), 0) AS averageDurationMs FROM ai_model_usage mu INNER JOIN ai_run_trace trace ON trace.run_id = mu.run_id WHERE trace.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mu.created_at >= #{startTime} AND mu.created_at < #{endTime}

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(mu.model_code, ''), 'UNKNOWN') AS modelCode, MAX(mu.provider) AS provider, MAX(mu.model_name) AS modelName, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(CASE WHEN mu.success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN mu.success = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failureCount, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN mu.success = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) END AS successRate, COALESCE(SUM(mu.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(mu.duration_ms)), 0) AS averageDurationMs FROM ai_model_usage mu INNER JOIN ai_run_trace trace ON trace.run_id = mu.run_id WHERE trace.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mu.created_at >= #{startTime} AND mu.created_at < #{endTime} GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(mu.model_code, ''), 'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY totalTokens DESC, callCount DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT mu.user_id AS userKey, COUNT(*) AS callCount, COALESCE(SUM(mu.total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, MAX(mu.created_at) AS lastUsedAt FROM ai_model_usage mu INNER JOIN ai_run_trace trace ON trace.run_id = mu.run_id WHERE trace.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND mu.user_id IS NOT NULL AND mu.user_id != '' AND mu.created_at >= #{startTime} AND mu.created_at < #{endTime} GROUP BY mu.user_id ORDER BY totalTokens DESC, callCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_document WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = 0) AS documentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_document WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = 0 AND status = 'PUBLISHED') AS publishedDocumentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_query_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at < #{endTime}) AS queryCount, (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND( SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) END FROM knowledge_query_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at < #{endTime}) AS querySuccessRate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_query_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'NO_RESULT' AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at < #{endTime}) AS noResultCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_query_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'FAILED' AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at < #{endTime}) AS failedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_base_vector_task WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') AND document_id IN ( SELECT id FROM knowledge_document WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} )) AS vectorPendingCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_base_vector_task WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND document_id IN ( SELECT id FROM knowledge_document WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} )) AS vectorFailedCount

SELECT CASE WHEN route.selected_capability_code IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('CAPABILITY:', route.selected_capability_code) WHEN trace.workflow_code IS NOT NULL AND trace.workflow_code != '' THEN CONCAT('WORKFLOW:', trace.workflow_code) ELSE CONCAT('ROUTE:', COALESCE(NULLIF(trace.route_type, ''), 'OTHER')) END AS `key`, MAX(CASE WHEN capability.capability_name IS NOT NULL THEN capability.capability_name WHEN workflow.workflow_name IS NOT NULL THEN workflow.workflow_name WHEN trace.route_type = 'RAG_ONLY' THEN '知识库问答' WHEN trace.route_type = 'BUSINESS_QUERY' THEN '业务数据查询' WHEN trace.route_type = 'MIXED_QUERY' THEN '综合业务查询' WHEN trace.route_type = 'STATISTIC_QUERY' THEN '统计分析' WHEN trace.route_type = 'WORKFLOW_QUERY' THEN '工作流查询' WHEN trace.route_type = 'WORKFLOW_ACTION' THEN '业务操作' WHEN trace.route_type = 'RESULT_ANALYSIS' THEN '结果追问分析' WHEN trace.route_type = 'CLARIFY' THEN '待补充信息' WHEN trace.route_type = 'REJECT' THEN '受限问题' ELSE '其他问题' END) AS displayQuestion, MAX(CASE WHEN capability.capability_name IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(capability.module_name, ''), NULLIF(capability.domain, ''), '业务能力') WHEN workflow.workflow_name IS NOT NULL THEN '工作流' WHEN trace.route_type = 'RAG_ONLY' THEN '知识问答' WHEN trace.route_type = 'DIRECT_CHAT' THEN '直接问答' ELSE '其他问题' END) AS topic, COUNT(*) AS questionCount, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(trace.user_id, '')) AS userCount, MAX(trace.created_at) AS lastAskedAt FROM ai_run_trace trace LEFT JOIN ai_capability_route_log route ON route.run_id = trace.run_id LEFT JOIN ai_capability_definition capability ON capability.capability_code = route.selected_capability_code LEFT JOIN ai_workflow_definition workflow ON workflow.workflow_code = trace.workflow_code WHERE trace.question IS NOT NULL AND trace.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND TRIM(trace.question) != '' AND trace.created_at >= #{startTime} AND trace.created_at < #{endTime} GROUP BY `key` ORDER BY questionCount DESC, lastAskedAt DESC LIMIT #{limit}
